project_type: SvelteKit static site (PWA) — public transparency portal for Navyuvak Chhath Puja Samiti, live at https://chhath.shaharpura.com
build_system: Vite 8 + @sveltejs/adapter-static + @vite-pwa/sveltekit. Node pinned via nvm: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" (PREPEND).
test_framework: vitest (run: npm test). Existing relevant tests: src/lib/seo.test.ts (SEO/OG/head), src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts (manifest icon pattern).
verification_instructions: From Public/frontend-v6 with the nvm PATH prepended: (1) npm ci; (2) npm run check — svelte-check --fail-on-warnings, MUST stay 0 errors / 0 warnings; (3) npm test — vitest, all green; (4) npm run build — MUST stay within CI JS budget. After build, confirm build/manifest.webmanifest is byte-identical to before the change (only expected diff is none for manifest), and grep the CSP in vercel.json / built headers to confirm cloudflareinsights is present in script-src and connect-src.
snapshot_or_generated_files: manifest.webmanifest and sitemap.xml are generated at build time (vite-plugin-pwa + routes/sitemap.xml/+server.ts). These must NOT change as a result of this task. No snapshot regen command needed for the changes here.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH"; cd Public/frontend-v6; npm ci (node_modules already present but run to be safe).
environment_constraints: Scope ALL changes to Public/frontend-v6 ONLY. Do NOT touch Public/frontend-v2..v5, backend, or mgmt apps. Do NOT push or open a PR (orchestrator handles publishing). CI job public-frontend-v6 enforces: npm run check (0/0), npm test, npm run build, total client JS <= 700000 bytes AND a per-page critical-path budget. None of the planned edits add JS.
contribution_requirements: vercel.json follows the Vercel JSON schema — do NOT add non-schema keys (e.g. a 'comment' key previously broke the schema). Only edit the Content-Security-Policy header VALUE. Keep the CSP a single valid string.
